questions.question:
Two Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some Ants are Bats.

Some Bats are Cats.

**Conclusions: **

I. Some Ants are Cats.

II. All Bats can never be Cats.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e17576fc6f4dc3573645cd83c54ee83c1df0894a29813a76c0b9665d5e160814.png] 

Conclusions: 

I. Some Ants are Cats → False (As Some Ants are Bats and Some Bats are Cats so, Some Ants are Cats is false)

II. All Bats can never be Cats → False (As Some Bats are Cats so, All Bats can never be Cats is false)

∴ Here, Both conclusions I and II are false.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Neither conclusion I nor II follow".**

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets. (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(4, 6, 72)

(5, 7, 105)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

(First number × Second number) × 3 = Third number

 
• (4, 6, 72) → (4 × 6) × 3 = 24 × 3 = 72

and

 
• (5, 7, 105) → (5 × 7) × 3 = 35 × 3 = 105

Similarly,

 
• **(6, 8, 144) → (6 × 8) × 3 = 48 × 3 = 144**

**Hence, the correct answer is "(6, 8, 144)".**

questions.question:
Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

192 ÷ 12 × 6 + 16 - 18 = 66
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Option 1) : 16 and 18

Given equation is : 192 ÷ 12 × 6 + 16 - 18 = 66

After interchanging the two number the equation is as follows : 192 ÷ 12 × 6 + 18 - 16 = 66

⇒ __**192 ÷ 12**__ × 6 + 18 - 16 = 66

⇒ __**16 × 6**__ + 18 - 16 = 66

⇒ __**96 + 18**__ - 16 = 66

⇒ __**114 - 16**__ = 66

⇒ 98 ≠ 66

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : 16 and 6

Given equation is : 192 ÷ 12 × 6 + 16 - 18 = 66

After interchanging the two number the equation is as follows : 192 ÷ 12 × 16 + 6 - 18 = 66

⇒ __**192 ÷ 12**__ × 16 + 6 - 18 = 66

⇒ __**16 × 16**__ + 6 - 18 = 66

⇒ __**256 + 6**__ - 18 = 66

⇒ __**262 - 18**__ = 66

⇒ 244 ≠ 66

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : 6 and 18

Given equation is : 192 ÷ 12 × 6 + 16 - 18 = 66

After interchanging the two number the equation is as follows : 192 ÷ 12 × 18 + 16 - 6 = 66

⇒ __**192 ÷ 12**__ × 18 + 16 - 6 = 66

⇒ __**16 × 18**__ + 16 - 6 = 66

⇒ __**288 + 16 **__- 6 = 66

⇒ __**304 - 6**__ = 66

⇒ 298 ≠ 66

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : 16 and 12

Given equation is : 192 ÷ 12 × 6 + 16 - 18 = 66

After interchanging the two number the equation is as follows : 192 ÷ 16 × 6 + 12 - 18 = 66

⇒ __**192 ÷ 16**__ × 6 + 12 - 18 = 66

⇒ __**12 × 6**__ + 12 - 18 = 66

⇒ __**72 + 12**__ - 18 = 66

⇒ __**84 - 18**__ = 66

⇒ **66 = 66**

**LHS = RHS**

Hence, the correct answer is **"16 and 12".**

questions.question:
If A denotes 'addition', B denotes 'multiplication', C denotes 'subtraction', and D denotes 'division', then what will be the value of the following equation?

7 B 5 A 31 C (48 D 6) = ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e50723751bca1df33fc1f030f78c1eac3344f2cdb432474cd432c6df783a12ab.png] 

 
 

 Alphabet
 A
 B
 C
 D
 
 

 Means
 +
 × 
 -
 ÷ 
 
 

The given expression : 7 B 5 A 31 C (48 D 6) = ?

After interchanging the symbols by mathematical operators the expression is as follows : 7 × 5 + 31 - (48 ÷ 6)

= 7 × 5 + 31 - __**(48 ÷ 6)**__

= __**7 × 5**__ + 31 - 8

= __**35 + 31**__ - 8

= __**66 - 8**__

= **58**

Hence, the correct answer is **"58".**

Second number = (First number¹/² + 1)² + 1

Similarly,

 
• **841 : ? → (841¹/² + 1)² + 1 = (29 + 1)² + 1 = 30² + 1 = 900 + 1 = 901**

questions.question: Height of Rahul, Hardik, Surya, Mohan and Kamal are compared. Height of Rahul is less than only three persons. Height of Surya is neither more nor less than the height of Rahul. Height of Kamal is more than Mohan but less than Hardik. Height of how many persons is more than Surya but less than Hardik?
questions.solution:
Given Persons: Rahul, Hardik, Surya, Mohan and Kamal.

1) Height of Rahul is less than only three persons.

2) Height of Surya is neither more nor less than the height of Rahul - This implies that the height of Surya and Rahul will be same.

__ > __ > __ > Rahul = Surya

3) Height of Kamal is more than Mohan but less than Hardik.

Hardik > Kamal > Mohan > Rahul = Surya

So, there are 2 persons height is more than Surya but less than Hardik.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
